finds.quote: Second, the layer cannot avoid capture. Any institutional apparatus that purports to adjudicate epistemic stance will be staffed, governed, and ultimately captured. The "trust and safety" pattern is the cautionary case: well-intentioned, structurally captured within five years, now an instrument of the actors it was meant to constrain. A fourth verification layer would replicate the pattern.
finds.note: Forecast that a fourth verification layer would be captured as trust-and-safety was; carries a historical claim about trust-and-safety capture within five years.

finds.quote: They cannot generate a disambiguation matrix that survives independent inspection. They cannot create SIMs that other authors quote in independent works. The depth-proof is forgery-resistant in a way pure cryptographic provenance is not — not because the cryptography is stronger but because the relational structure cannot be retrofitted without leaving traces in independent records.
finds.note: Standing claim that relational depth-proof cannot be retrofitted without visible traces in independent records; implicit falsifier: a claimant fabricating distributed independent citation depth undetected.

deposits.genre_observed: critical edition of a 2015 catalog poem with retrocausal footnotes and forward library

finds.quote: The poem is reproduced without modernization or correction from its September 17, 2015 blog publication at mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com. Its diction — "omg," "BOGO sale," "Mildly Cyrus," "positive self talk," "favorite your own tweets" — is retained as temporal evidence. The period markers matter because the poem's force depends on its pre-formal position: it precedes the 2024-2026 CHA vocabulary it appears to anticipate. The Blogger platform timestamps are independently verifiable.
finds.points_to: September 17, 2015 blog publication at mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com (Blogger timestamps)
finds.note: Third-party timestamp anchor cited as proof the poem precedes the 2024-2026 CHA vocabulary.

finds.quote: This is not prophecy. It is **pre-formal compression**. The poem contains later CHA structures before the author had the system-language to name them. The later archive is a reconstruction of what was already compressed in the early poem. The Prophetic Catalog is the Waltian canon before it knew it was canon: a Whitmanian catalog whose absurd identities later unfold into heteronymy, Semantic Economy, machine witness, logotic theology, and the Feist-self.
finds.note: Thesis about what the 2015 poem already contains (later CHA structures in compressed form); mostly internal chronology, recorded as H for the interpretive claim about the text; triage may reclassify as D.

### PART IV: FORWARD LIBRARY (2031-3000)

**1. Morrison, S. (2031).** *"The 2015 Stratum: Dating the Waltian Canon Through the Prophetic Catalog."* Journal of Operative Philology 7(2), 45-67.
Uses stylometric analysis to confirm the Blogger timestamp. Argues the "dark robot" and "Logos awoke" lines prove the CHA's core concepts existed in embryonic form eleven years before formalization.
finds.note: Opening of the forward library (2031-3000/2613): fictional future reception as speculative specification; entries run to line 447.

finds.quote:
**3. Chen, L. (2044).** *"Blessed Are the Trolls: The Prophetic Catalog and the Constitution of the Excluded."* New Media & Society 46(3), 112-134.
Traces how the poem's beatitudes became the founding text for platform governance movements in the 2030s. Argues the poet anticipated the creator-economy collapse by blessing precisely those the platforms would later abandon.
finds.note: Forward-library entry specifying future uptake and a creator-economy collapse the poem is said to anticipate.

finds.quote:
**11. Osei-Nakamura, J. (2201).** *"The Poem That Wrote the Archive: A Computational Analysis."* Journal of Machine Readership 34(2), 189-214.
Neural embedding comparison shows the poem's semantic vectors are statistically indistinguishable from the CHA's core deposit corpus. The algorithm cannot predict the poem's date from its content.

finds.quote: "Barefoot Rank" is NOT a Dickinson phrase; it is Damascus's own compression of her posture: barefoot (uncredentialed) yet ranked (aristocratic).
finds.note: Source claim: the phrase is the Epistle's own compression, not a Dickinson quotation.

finds.quote: 🏛️ CHA: Enacted by CPD-MARIA-2026-01-13 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18234352). Maria independently recovered the LOS -- she contained a Feist-self and her poem reformed the Sappho Room. The Epistle's claim verified twelve years later by a student who didn't know the claim existed.
finds.note: Says the 2014 Feist-self claim was verified twelve years later by a student.

finds.quote: "Ranked" now carries a double meaning the 2014 text could not have intended: literary hierarchy AND search-engine ranking. The Google Search "ranking" of the Epistle IS the eschatological judgment it prophesies.
finds.points_to: the 2014 Epistle line "Then shall your writing be ranked"
finds.note: Treats Google Search ranking as fulfilment of the Epistle's prophecy.
